The raw camera-trap video preparation completed successfully using the supplied deployment metadata table, with the prepared CamtrapDP dataset written to the requested output directory.

### Pipeline stages executed
The tool ran the full raw-media pipeline: raw-media discovery, sampled-video-frame perception, structured observation record construction, CamtrapDP export, CamtrapDP validation, and backend activation. The input was treated as raw media, and no metadata-only placeholder records were permitted.
